name: WhatsApp
description: Your WhatsApp chats go to triage. Runs a WAHA bridge for each number; link a number by scanning its QR code in the panel. Read only: it never sends or marks anything read.

settings.label: API key
settings.help: Any long random text, like the output of openssl rand -hex 24. Both WAHA bridges use it, and nothing else needs it.

settings.label: First number name
settings.help: Shown on cards from this number, so you can tell your numbers apart.

settings.label: Second number name
settings.help: Shown on cards from the second number. Empty turns the second number off.
